transformations.what: runs of whitespace and newlines collapsed to single spaces
transformations.why: arXiv wraps the abstract for display; the wrapping is not content
the repository is ASCII-only and enforces it in CI
transformations.note: an accented letter survives as its base letter; a character with no ASCII decomposition is DELETED, which is why chars_dropped is recorded per record and shown to the reviewer before the choice

transformations.what: cut at the last sentence boundary at or before 600 characters
transformations.why: event_v1 allows 1000; 600 is an editorial choice, not a schema requirement, so it is named here as a choice
transformations.note: applied only when the abstract exceeds the limit; is_excerpt records it

audit_chain: <- this dump's data.jsonl, field abstract (verbatim, unmodified)
<- entry_id, the versioned arXiv Atom entry this was read from
note: Abstracts for records in enriched_alignment_research_events.json, which has no raw provenance in this repo. See pdoom-data#88.
